# Stolt of Sweden

> Swedish brand making BootSki short skis (fun, compact skis not much longer
> than the sole of a ski boot) and ST-50 ski goggles.
> Based in Sweden, shipping directly from Sweden.

All facts below are taken from the official Stolt of Sweden store.

## Products

- BootSki (short skis) — the world's smallest ski with a design patented design.
  - A short ski: not much longer than the sole of a ski boot.
  - Universal fit: compatible with all DIN-type ski boots.
  - A perfect add-on and a fun alternative to traditional skis.
  - Can be both waxed and sharpened.
  - Sizes: Adult Medium, Adult Large, Kids (= Small in the size chart).
  - Every package includes: 1 pair of BootSkis, 1 ultra-flexible storage bag,
    2 extra metal strings for binding adjustment.
  - Price: 1 995 SEK (solid colours) or 2 195 SEK (carbon prints).
- ST-50 Black Ski Goggles with Spare Lens — 1 499 SEK, arriving October 2026.
  - Double Lens Toric for a wider field of view with less edge distortion.
  - S3 Grey/Silver Mirror main lens fitted; S1 Clear Grey spare lens included.
  - Magnetic Lens Quick Change System.
  - 100% UV400 protection and anti-fog coating.
  - OTG (Over-The-Glasses) design.
  - Article no. 2050-31, EAN 7350114020009. Designed in Sweden, made in China.
  - Included: goggles with S3 lens fitted, S1 spare lens, hard EVA case,
    two-compartment pouch.

## Shipping

- Dispatched from Sweden within 1-2 working days.
- Delivery about 2-5 days to most countries in Europe; longer outside Europe.
- VAT included in EU countries; VAT and customs may apply outside the EU.
